source.working_tree: task 10-03 changes are uncommitted by runner contract

instrumentation.scope: The controller records graph-key admission, direct page-table payload bytes, and scratch watermarks. dense.reason: No task-local route-comparison runner exposes the identical prompt/output stream and the new selected-route counters together.

selected_direct.reason: The registered fixture validates the direct Turbo4 page kernel, not end-to-end Qwen graph output.

trial_contract.reason: A dense/reference/direct model-backed harness with shared prompts, logits, route labels, and per-token counters is not registered in this repository.

resource_and_safety_evidence.result: bounded direct fixture and VMM checks pass; live graph/table-update replay remains deferred

bottlenecks: The direct graph currently rewrites page-table and native-position inputs on each submission; the measured table payload is bounded but not yet amortized by a live capture harness.
Descriptor-copy, kernel, and total-token counters are wired at the production boundary, but no model run has populated all three timing classes.
The next prefill task must establish a shared route-control harness before dynamic selection or a speed gate is meaningful.
